Sections 1/2/3 originally suggested per-section forge test invocations that couldn't compile (test file imports functions not yet written). Replaced with forge build only + a note that the test gate runs at the end.

PR-review fix: added a zero-owner guard in `_requireAuthorized` (reject `ens.owner(node) == address(0)` before the approval check) plus a zero-registry guard in the constructor, with a 9th test `test_setWalrusBlob_revertsForUnownedNode`. Re-ran: 9/9.
